quests.name: The Redheaded Bandit
quests.offer: Bram D'Lizo owes me a favour. He camps with the gypsies on the north shore past the Fayspires lake, west of the fort. Go to him and do what he asks.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Bram is a hard man, but fair. Go.

steps.journal: Find Bram D'Lizo at the gypsy camp west of the fort north of the Fayspires lake, and pay him 1,200 tunar.
steps.says: Coin first, always. Now: a red-haired bandit rides with the arctic bandits east of here. Kill him, take his bandana to Feria.
steps.notyet: Twelve hundred tunar first. Then we talk.

steps.journal: Kill the red-haired arctic bandit near the bandit fort and take his bandana.
Bring the red bandana to Feria Hurkert in Hodstock.
steps.says: So he is dead at last. Speak with my daughter Drew. She has something for you.

steps.journal: Speak with Drew Hurkert.
steps.says: Mother told me what you did. Take these, with our thanks.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/23.json, PART ONE (ABILITY) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Redheaded Bandit is one of the arctic bandits (EQOA-Data's map: Arctic Bandit with red hair), so any arctic bandit may drop his bandana; the bandana is ours, the guide names no item. The experience is ours (the guide gives none for this part). The item is the first of the class's reward list, the ability the second (the guide lists each class's items and ability together, part one's first); the guide lists no item for the other classes. The ability is each class's of this level that EQOA-Data's spell lists mark Quest (Information/databases/spells; of a pair, the one a class mastery replaces).

quests.name: The Glowing Shield
quests.offer: You have been a friend to us. Merchant Yulia in Freeport, through the second west door of the main hall, sells a runic recording. Buy it and show it to Bram D'Lizo. He will know where it leads.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Buy a runic recording from Merchant Yulia in Freeport (1,200 tunar).
steps.says: One runic recording. Mind it does not get wet.

steps.journal: Show the runic recording to Bram D'Lizo.
steps.says: So that is what it says. North of the bandit fort stands a statue with a glowing shield. Go to it.

steps.journal: Find the statue with the glowing shield north of the bandit fort.

events.text: The statue's shield glows as you come near. A voice speaks of Greyvax's caves to the north-west, and of the frozen dead that walk there.

steps.journal: Kill iceflesh zombies in Greyvax's caves until one gives up a tribal pendant.
Bring the tribal pendant to Feria Hurkert.
steps.says: The pendant of my people. You have done more than I asked of you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/23.json, PART TWO (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Offered with 150 standing with Feria Hurkert (the guide's good faction with her, raised by killing the Cracktooth orcs near Bobble-by-the-Water: that needs a factionhits row for them, which this file cannot add). The statue's place is EQOA-Data's map's, and the voice that sends you to Greyvax's caves is ours (the guide only says the statue directs you). The pendant drops with our chance. The experience is ours; the items are the third of each class's list in the guide (no ability in this part).

quests.name: The Remains of Manger MacGray
quests.offer: An old friend of ours, Manger MacGray, went into the north and did not come back. Guard Smitty in Freeport, who keeps the door of a building there, knows something. Ask him.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Guard Smitty at his door in Freeport and pay him 1,200 tunar.
steps.says: For that: ask Bison, in the Freezeblood village of Everfrost. South-west of Halas, in the caves in the mountains.
steps.notyet: Twelve hundred tunar loosens my tongue. Nothing less.

steps.journal: Find Bison in Everfrost, south-west of Halas, and ask about Manger MacGray.
steps.says: MacGray? Greyvax took him, and what is left of him is still in that cave. Tell Feria.

steps.journal: Tell Feria Hurkert what Bison said.
steps.says: Then bring him home to us. Find the room with the ice statue in Greyvax's cave. Mind the rats there.

steps.journal: Find the ice statue in Greyvax's cave and speak to it.
steps.says: Free... You have freed me. Take my key. What you seek is in the frozen chest.

steps.journal: Open the frosty chest beside the ice statue with the ice key.

events.text: The ice key turns in the lock. Inside lie the frozen remains of Manger MacGray.

steps.journal: Bring the remains of Manger MacGray to Feria Hurkert.
steps.says: He is home. Thank you, friend. Take these.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/23.json, PART THREE (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's choice at the ice statue (release it or not) is one way here: the statue is freed and gives the ice key. The chaos rats round it are the server's own. The experience is ours; the items are the fourth of each class's list in the guide. Offered with the same standing with Feria Hurkert as part two, which it follows.

quests.name: The Temby Debt
quests.offer: Nascien Vladya drinks at the Smiling Serpent in Freeport, the bar, not the inn. He has work that needs doing, and I want it done. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Nascien Vladya at the Smiling Serpent bar in Freeport; he wants 790 tunar.
steps.says: Razuam Marus, in Wyndhaven: upstairs at the inn by the coach. Kill him and take his signet to Dristan.
steps.notyet: Seven hundred and ninety tunar. Then I talk.

steps.journal: Kill Razuam Marus upstairs at the inn in Wyndhaven and take his signet.
Bring the signet of Razuam Marus to Dristan Blane.
steps.says: Razuam will trouble no one again. Temby will remember this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/25.json, Temby Quest (ABILITY) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The signet is ours (the guide names no item). The experience and the faction are ours: the guide gives XP, an ability and faction, no figures; the faction is Temby's smugglers'. The guide's note that low standing with Temby is raised by killing Nasehir is not a gate here (it gives no standing). The ability is each class's of this level that EQOA-Data's spell lists mark Quest (Information/databases/spells; of a pair, the one a class mastery replaces).

quests.name: The Ancient Stone Golem
quests.offer: My master needs a stone from the heart of the ancient stone golem. It roams by a small bridge north of the river in Mayfly Glade, west of Forkwatch, near a guard tower. Bring me one.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill the ancient stone golem by the small bridge in Mayfly Glade.
Bring the ancient golem stone to Apprentice Buerma in Darvar Manor.
steps.says: Good, good. Now Ling, nearby, wants paying for her part. See her.

steps.journal: Pay Ling, near the blacksmith by the inn, 1,200 tunar.
steps.says: That settles it. Tell Buerma.

steps.journal: Return to Apprentice Buerma.
steps.says: My master will be pleased. Here, for your trouble.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/25.json, Black Swan Inn Side Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The stone is ours (the guide names no item), and Ling's fee the guide's uncertain 1,200. The reward is ours: the guide only says Buerma rewards you. The guide's note that Buerma must be friendly (raised by killing gnolls in Blackburrow, Jethro's Cast or the bandits of Bandit Hills) gives no standing, so it is not a gate here.

quests.name: The Enraged Wolf
quests.offer: An enraged wolf runs east of town and nothing is safe from it. Kill it and bring me its pelt, and I will see you right.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill the enraged wolf east of Wyndhaven.
Bring the enraged wolf pelt to Mister Bail.
steps.says: Good riddance. Now: Danur Ironbrow, on the farm by Bethany's south of the Bear Caves, has something for me. Pay him.

steps.journal: Find Danur Ironbrow on the farm in the Hagley farmlands and pay him 782 tunar.
steps.says: Bail's money, is it? Tell him we are square.

steps.journal: Return to Mister Bail in Wyndhaven.
steps.says: Square, is it? Good. This is yours.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/25.json, Wyndhaven Side Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide says Mister Bail gives an item, XP and an ability without naming them: the ability here is the level's (as Temby's quest gives; a class that has it from one keeps it, a scribe never teaches one twice), the experience ours and the item left out. The pelt is ours. The ability is each class's of this level that EQOA-Data's spell lists mark Quest (Information/databases/spells; of a pair, the one a class mastery replaces).

quests.name: The Goblin Poison
quests.offer: Goblins creep into this tower. One of their fanatics is inside the walls now. Kill it and bring me whatever it carries.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill the goblin fanatic inside the tower's walls and take what it carries.
Bring the scrawled note to Commander Dursley.
steps.says: Poison! Skulpik means to poison us. He lairs deep in Runnyeye Citadel. Kill him and bring me his recipe.

steps.journal: Kill Skulpik deep in Runnyeye Citadel and take his recipe.
Bring the recipe to Commander Dursley.
steps.says: Take it to Quando Faircoin in Highpass, the white church past the old bank. He can make the antidote.

steps.journal: Have Quando Faircoin in Highpass make the antidote; he wants the recipe and 1,450 tunar.
steps.says: An odd recipe, but it will serve. Here is your antidote.

steps.journal: Bring the antidote to Commander Dursley.
steps.says: We are safe. Saerk has your reward. Go down, into the other tower, touch the orb and go up.

steps.journal: Go into the other tower, touch the orb of light and go up to Saerk.
steps.says: Dursley speaks well of you. Learn this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/27.json, Part One (ABILITY) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The antidote is ours by name. The guide's item is not named, so it is left out; the experience is the guide's. The ability is each class's of this level that EQOA-Data's spell lists mark Quest (Information/databases/spells; of a pair, the one a class mastery replaces). EQOA-Data's lists give no quest ability of this level for the necromancer, so that class gets none here.

quests.name: Saerk's Ring
quests.offer: Bring me the Elemental Lexicon and Darkhart's Medallion from the old tower east of Melton, and a red diamond, and I will make you a ring.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Climb the old tower east of Melton, past its ghost, and take the Elemental Lexicon.

events.text: At the top of the tower, under dust and cobwebs, lies the Elemental Lexicon.

steps.journal: Follow the dirt tunnel under the tower to Darkhart's lair and kill him for his medallion.
Buy a red diamond from Grithmil Darkstone in Moradhim (1,450 tunar).
steps.says: A red diamond, the best in the mountain.

steps.journal: Bring the Elemental Lexicon, Darkhart's Medallion and the red diamond to Saerk.
steps.says: All three. Wear this well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/27.json, Part Two (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The lexicon is at the tower's place on EQOA-Data's map, taken there (the ghost that guards it is not in); the guide says to loot nothing on the way. The red diamond's price is ours (the guide gives none), and only Grithmil Darkstone sells it here (the guide's Tsekar in the Green Rift is the other seller). The guide's class-specific ring is not named: the four level-27 rings of one pattern no other source gives (Tactican's STR, Falcon DEX, Bishop's WIS, Burnished Gold INT, each with 50 health or power and 9 armour) are given by archetype, our reading. The experience is the guide's.

quests.name: Max's Journal
quests.offer: A wolf killed Max, and his journal went with him. The alpha hunts from the first cave east of the road, north of here. Kill it and bring me Max's journal.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill the alpha wolf in the first cave east of the road north of Trail's End.
Bring Max's journal to Two-Eyed Jack in Trail's End.
steps.says: Max's words, safe. Thank you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/30.json, Quest 1: Trails End Side Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Alpha-male Wolf is the silvermist wolf alpha the server has where EQOA-Data's map puts it (the guide's triggered spawn is always there here). Jack's belt of his own design is not named in the guide, so it is left out; the experience is the guide's.

quests.name: The Sacred Monarch
quests.offer: I need the wing of a sacred monarch. They flutter in the lit glade by the mayfly statue in Mayfly Glade, west of Forkwatch. Bring me one, and coin for my trouble.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill sacred monarchs in the lit glade of Mayfly Glade for a wing.
Bring the sacred monarch wing and 1,600 tunar to Twindle Fizzmop in Freeport.
steps.says: Lovely. And this circlet is yours.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/30.json, Quest 2: Freeport Side Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The wing is ours (the guide names no item). The experience is ours (the guide gives only the circlet). The guide's groups (this one the evil races' at 30) are not a gate here.

quests.name: Skarr
quests.offer: Skarr leads the gnolls of Blackburrow. In the main chamber, past the great hole, a passage south-west leads to him. Kill him and bring me proof. Their shamans see through invisibility.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Skarr, down the south-west passage off the great chamber of Blackburrow.
Bring Skarr's paw to Finnus Sodwin at the Black Swan Inn.
steps.says: Skarr is dead! Here, you have earned every coin.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/30.json, Quest 3: Black Swan Inn Side Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The paw is ours (the guide names no item); the rewards are the guide's.

quests.name: The Al'Karad Tablet
quests.offer: North of town, past where the road fades, lie the Al'Karad Ruins. Read the tablet deep in the dungeon there, then kill the savage bear that prowls the ruins and bring me its pelt.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find the tablet straight back in the dungeon of the Al'Karad Ruins.

events.text: The tablet tells of the beast that guards the ruins. Somewhere above, a savage bear roars.

steps.journal: Kill the savage bear at the Al'Karad Ruins and take its pelt.
Bring the savage bear pelt to Argot Bittersteel in Blakedown.
steps.says: That is the beast, sure enough. Wear this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/30.json, Quest 4: Blakedown Side Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The tablet's place is EQOA-Data's map's; what it says is ours. The bear stands at the ruins (the map's point; the server's other savage bears are level 43, far north, and count too). The pelt is ours; the rewards are the guide's.

quests.name: The U`Dedne Gem
quests.offer: Jongo Quicktoe stole a gem of my house. He hides in Runnyeye: from the citadel bridge drop down, past the ichor worms, and take the west passage. Kill him and bring it back.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Jongo Quicktoe down the west passage under Runnyeye's bridge and take the gem.
Bring the U`Dedne gem to J'Lisa U`Dedne in Fort Seriak.
steps.says: The gem of my house! You have my thanks, and my house's.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/30.json, Quest 5: Fort Seriak Side Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Jongo Quicktoe is the server's Quicktoe; the goblin he fights is not in. The rewards are the guide's (its +50 House of U'Dedne and +10 Indigo Brotherhood). The guide believes it is for the evil races only; that is not a gate here.

quests.name: Yismay's Tea
quests.offer: I am brewing a tea of rare power, and I need help. Killian Helnes at the Twin Tails Inn in Blackwater knows where the recipe went. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Killian Helnes at the Twin Tails Inn in Blackwater.
steps.says: Yismay's recipe? Tobul has it. He roams the ruins with the zintec zombies in Widow's Peak, west and a little south of here. Take it from him.

steps.journal: Kill Tobul at the ruins in Widow's Peak and take the recipe.
Bring the recipe to Teamaster Yismay.
steps.says: Now tinsy tea leaves and brackish rocks. Captain Hogofa in north-western Ro can get the leaves. Take him 1,625 tunar.

steps.journal: Take 1,625 tunar to Captain Hogofa in north-western Ro.
steps.says: Skorn, in the next tent, has the leaves. Tell him I sent you.

steps.journal: Get the tinsy tea leaves from Captain Skorn in the next tent.
steps.says: Tinsy tea leaves. Do not steep them too long.

steps.journal: Kill Deathfist riders at the Deathfist Citadel's tower for brackish rocks.
Bring the tea leaves and the brackish rocks to Teamaster Yismay.
steps.says: One thing more: Niktuu's antique teapot, in the Tomb of Kings. Kill him and bring it to me.

steps.journal: Kill Niktuu at the end of the second dug tunnel in the Tomb of Kings and take his teapot.
Bring the antique teapot to Teamaster Yismay.
steps.says: Perfect. Sit, drink, and learn.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/33.json, Quest 1: Muniel's Tea Garden Quest (ABILITY) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Captain Ogofa is Captain Hogofa. The recipe and teapot are named by the guide, the rest ours; the rocks drop with our chance. The guide's item is not named and is left out; the experience is the guide's. The ability is each class's of this level that EQOA-Data's spell lists mark Quest (Information/databases/spells; of a pair, the one a class mastery replaces).

quests.name: The Eye of the Wyrm
quests.offer: There is a map, cut in two, that leads to the Eye of the Wyrm. Cambrick Scott in Muniel's Tea Garden sells one half. Buy it and bring it to me.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Buy the map from Cambrick Scott in Muniel's Tea Garden (1,625 tunar).
steps.says: Half a map, and worth every coin.

steps.journal: Show the half of a map to Connor Dunn in Bastable.
steps.says: Father Manstein in southern Blakedown can read the other half. Take it to him.

steps.journal: Take the map to Father Manstein in southern Blakedown.
steps.says: To read it I need the blood of a vampire from Melissa's Tomb, and the spark of an emberfly from the island in the Spider Mine's lake.

steps.journal: Kill the fledgling vampire on the main floor of Melissa's Tomb, north of Blakedown.
Kill emberflies on the island in the Spider Mine's lake for a spark.
Bring the blood of a vampire and the spark of an emberfly to Father Manstein.
steps.says: It reads: those that seek the Eye of the Wyrm must go to Melissa's Tomb, place the Key of Three, and defeat Lorx, or meet their doom.

steps.journal: Go to the fountain in the main room of Melissa's Tomb.

events.text: You place the blood, the spark and the map in the fountain: the Key of Three. The water boils, and Lorx the wyrm rises!

steps.journal: Kill Lorx Wyrm and take the Eye of the Wyrm.
Bring the Eye of the Wyrm to Connor Dunn.
steps.says: The Eye! Open the chest beside me: what is in it is yours.

steps.journal: Open the chest beside Connor Dunn.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/33.json, Quest 2: Bastable Village Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Father Manstien is the game's Father Manstein, its Emberfly the golden emberfly, the chest beside Connor the Ornate Chest. The Key of Three is the three things placed in the fountain (no item of its own), and Lorx stands in the tomb here (the guide's popup spawn). The guide's three tasks for Manstein name two; both are in. Items but the guide's blood and spark are ours; the reward is ours (the guide only says the chest holds it).

quests.name: Redsen's Errands
quests.offer: A man called Keller roams Mayfly Glade with a letter of mine he had no right to. Kill him and bring it back.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Keller, who roams Mayfly Glade, and take back the letter.
Bring the letter to Johan Redsen in Blakedown.
steps.says: Good. Dominic Sorelli by the north gate of Highpass sells rare herbs I need. Buy them for me.

steps.journal: Buy rare herbs from Dominic Sorelli by the north gate of Highpass (1,625 tunar).
steps.says: Rare indeed. Here you are.

steps.journal: Bring the rare herbs to Johan Redsen.
steps.says: Hawkblade mercenaries in Ferran's Hope, south-west of Highpass, have a golden mayfly idol of mine. Get it back.

steps.journal: Kill Hawkblade mercenaries in Ferran's Hope for the golden mayfly idol.
Bring the golden mayfly idol to Johan Redsen.
steps.says: Last: the defiler prince in the great slith tar hive west of Hazinak. Bring me his stinger.

steps.journal: Kill the slith tar defiler prince in the largest hive west of Hazinak.
Bring the defiler prince's stinger to Johan Redsen.
steps.says: All of it. You have my thanks.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/33.json, Quest 3: Blakedown Side Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The defiler prince is the server's slith tar defiler princ (its name cut short). The guide's golden mayfly idol is its; the other items are ours. The reward is ours (the guide only says Redsen rewards you).

quests.name: The Idols of Zsetikaowa
quests.offer: Priestess Nadya of the white church has a task for the faithful, and the faithful are few just now. Go to her.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak with Priestess Nadya in Highpass's white church.
steps.says: Madam Thlae in Wyndhaven, the southernmost hut on the coast, keeps blessed ivory. Buy some and bring it to me.

steps.journal: Buy blessed ivory from Madam Thlae in Wyndhaven (2,325 tunar).
steps.says: Blessed ivory. Carry it carefully.

steps.journal: Bring the blessed ivory to Priestess Nadya.
steps.says: Good. Tell Demetrios it is done; he will know what comes next.

steps.journal: Return to Demetrios Velspane on the second floor of the keep.
steps.says: Lusciar Mekara, at the inn by Freeport's southern entrance, knows of two idols we must have. Go to him.

steps.journal: Find Lusciar Mekara at the inn by Freeport's southern entrance.
steps.says: The Idol of Malice: Yjuri the Vicious keeps it in Blackburrow. The Idol of Lust: Tseralith, at the tower of Noctix in Mu Lin's Reach. Bring me both.

steps.journal: Kill Yjuri the Vicious in Blackburrow's bottom left-hand tunnel for the Idol of Malice.
Kill Tseralith by the tower of Noctix in Mu Lin's Reach for the Idol of Lust.
Bring both idols to Lusciar Mekara.
steps.says: Together they make the Idol of Zsetikaowa. Take it to the Pool of Tears in Hazinak, and be ready.

steps.journal: Take the Idol of Zsetikaowa to the Pool of Tears in Hazinak.

events.text: The idol grows cold in your hands. Something stirs in the Pool of Tears!

steps.journal: Kill Zsetikaowa at the Pool of Tears.
Bring the essence of Zsetikaowa to Lusciar Mekara.
steps.says: It is ended. Go back to Priestess Nadya.

steps.journal: Return to Priestess Nadya.
steps.says: Demetrios is waiting for you.

steps.journal: Return to Demetrios Velspane.
steps.says: You have done Highpass a great service. Learn this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/35.json, Quest 1: Highpass Hold Ability Quest (ABILITY) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Dametrios is the game's Demetrios Velspane. Yjuri and Zsetikaowa stand where they are seen (the guide's popup spawns); the Pool of Tears is Zsetikaowa's place. The idols are the guide's, the essence ours; the guide's item is not named and is left out; the experience is the guide's. The ability is each class's of this level that EQOA-Data's spell lists mark Quest (Information/databases/spells; of a pair, the one a class mastery replaces).

quests.name: The Seal of Deiphobus
quests.offer: A creature called Phoborium haunts the hill west of the river by Bastable. Kill it and bring me its horn. Then we will talk about the rest.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Phoborium on the hill west of the river by Bastable.
Bring Phoborium's horn to Ambrose Castor in Highpass.
steps.says: Good. Iulias Maphesti in Freeport needs a hand. Help him, and come back.

steps.journal: Find Iulias Maphesti in Freeport.
steps.says: Kill Caelduiel the Sacred at the Al'Farek ruins, south of the great Nasehir village, west to the blue stones. And pay Lelaia Shavrell in Temby for her seal.

steps.journal: Kill Caelduiel the Sacred at the blue stones of the Al'Farek ruins.
Pay Lelaia Shavrell in Temby 2,325 tunar for her seal.
steps.says: The seal is yours. Do not lose it.

steps.journal: Bring Caelduiel's charm to Iulias Maphesti.
steps.says: Good. Keep Lelaia's seal: Ambrose will want it. Go back to him.

steps.journal: Return to Ambrose Castor.
steps.says: Place the seal at the south crossroads of Dark Solace. Deiphobus will answer it. Kill him.

steps.journal: Place the seal at the south crossroads of Dark Solace.

events.text: You set down the seal. The air turns foul: Deiphobus answers its call!

steps.journal: Kill Deiphobus at the crossroads of Dark Solace.
Bring Deiphobus's skull to Ambrose Castor.
steps.says: You have done well. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/35.json, Quest 2: Ambrose Castor Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). quests.name: Margun Leafstrider
quests.offer: To summon Margun Leafstrider I need a ball of Everfrost, from the Ice Goblin Melder in Lady Vox's castle in Permafrost, and an ancient bottle of elven wine from Merchant Gilgash in Freeport. Bring both.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill the Ice Goblin Melder in Lady Vox's castle in Permafrost.
Buy an ancient bottle of elven wine from Merchant Gilgash in Freeport (3,000 tunar).
steps.says: The oldest bottle I have.

steps.journal: Bring the ball of Everfrost and the elven wine to Grimm Brellhand.
steps.says: Now go to the hollow tree north of here and call Margun Leafstrider.

steps.journal: Go to the hollow tree north of Grimm Brellhand.

events.text: You set the ball of Everfrost in the hollow tree and pour out the wine. Margun Leafstrider steps out of the bark.

steps.journal: Speak with Margun Leafstrider.
steps.says: You called me. Tilmiraen, in the small bowl valley north of the first hill in the Deathfist Forge, can give what Grimm needs.

steps.journal: Find Tilmiraen in the small bowl valley north of the first hill of the Deathfist Forge.
steps.says: I will help, if you help me. Mugwort, in the fairy village of the Twisted Towers, knows what I need. I will send you, in a fairy's shape.

steps.journal: Find Mugwort in the mushroom house at the far east of the fairy village.
steps.says: Tilmiraen sent you? Tell him: Twizzletwig, in Takish`Hiz. Back through the tiny door with you.

steps.journal: Return to Tilmiraen.
steps.says: Twizzletwig, then. He walks the road south of the blue lake in Takish`Hiz. Kill him and bring me his potion of ever-rot.

steps.journal: Kill Twizzletwig on the road south of the blue lake in Takish`Hiz.
Bring the potion of ever-rot to Tilmiraen.
steps.says: As promised, a root of my tree. Take it to Grimm.

steps.journal: Bring Tilmiraen's root to Grimm Brellhand.
steps.says: With this the work is done. Learn what I teach.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/47.json, Quest 2: Gramash Ruins (ABILITY) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The trip to the fairy village is a teleport to Mugwort and back to Tilmiraen (the guide's tiny door); the fairy shape is not in, so dying there costs nothing. The branch Tilmiraen first gives is not in, nor the guide's placeholders for the Melder; Twizzletwig walks his road (his popup spawn). The guide's items are its; the class item is not named and is left out; the experience is ours (the guide gives none for this part: Quest 1's). The ability is each class's of this level that EQOA-Data's spell lists mark Quest (Information/databases/spells; of a pair, the one a class mastery replaces). EQOA-Data's lists give no quest ability of this level for the rogue, so that class gets none here. The rogue's level 47 ability is a mob drop in EQOA-Data's list.

quests.name: The Thulite Anvil
quests.offer: My hammer broke my anvil. A new one wants thulite. The dark elf miner in Cazic Thule's pyramid keeps a mining log that says where. Bring it to me.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill the dark elf miner on the right side of Cazic Thule's pyramid for his log.
Bring the mining log to Grimm Brellhand.
steps.says: Maerik N'Toxis, in the castle at the bottom of Guk, has two scrolls the log speaks of. Bring them.

steps.journal: Kill Maerik N'Toxis in the castle at the bottom of Guk for his scrolls.
Bring Maerik's scrolls to Grimm Brellhand.
steps.says: I cannot read these. Feldink Shortquill in Highpass can: second floor of Lord Voriander's tower.

steps.journal: Have Feldink Shortquill in Highpass translate the scrolls (3,000 tunar).
steps.says: Here, in plain words.

steps.journal: Bring the translated scrolls to Grimm Brellhand.
steps.says: We wake the Thulite golem in Tak`Xiv. The golem protectors in the hut on the walkway carry its parts. Bring both.

steps.journal: Kill golem protectors in the hut on the walkway in Tak`Xiv for the first part.
Kill golem protectors for the second part.
Fit the two parts into the Thulite golem.

events.text: The parts lock into place. The Thulite golem's eyes kindle, and it rises to fight!

steps.journal: Kill the Thulite golem and take its huge chunks of thulite.
Bring the huge chunks of thulite to Grimm Brellhand.
steps.says: A new anvil! Thank you, friend.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/23-47/47.json, Quest 3: Gramash Ruins (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Maerik's two scrolls drop together (the guide's hours of placeholders are not in), and the golem's four chunks are one item. The Thulite golem stands woken (the guide's activation is the reach step's popup). The items are ours; the guide's class item is not named and is left out; the experience is ours (the guide gives none).
